reason: Two live sampled-out HTTP roots consume the default two annotation slots despite holding no analysis permits; an independently admitted active request gets neither a bound reporting annotation nor orphan capacity on Go 1.26.6 and 1.27.0. The README documents sampling and bounded drops, not starvation of admitted analyses by sampled-out roots.
repro_command: Copy evidence/fx-life-weak-gc-F1/review_independent_starvation_test.go to internal/spans/review_independent_starvation_test.go in a private copy, then run GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 go test -count=1 -timeout 12m -run '^TestIndependentActiveRequestKeepsItsReportingSlot$' -v ./internal/spans/
